findings.title: Structural ratchet prices only the largest class: 1201 lines added to HeatPumpOptimizer move 0 of 16 budget keys
findings.claim: Adding 1201 lines of called, non-duplicated, CC-1 code to the second-largest class (HeatPumpOptimizer, 3510 lines) moves none of the 16 structure_budgets.json keys. The same pad in the coordinator moves max_class_loc from 8705 to 9906.
findings.mechanism: measure() sets max_class_loc = max(loc over god classes), so a class below the coordinator can grow by up to 8705-3510=5195 lines unpriced. This is the 'only the worst is priced' shape that #374 fixed for functions.

evidence.contention_note: shared fan-out box, load1 68-84; counts are contention-immune

perturbation.change: in tests/structure.py:measure replace "max_class_loc": max((g[0] for g in god_classes), default=0) with sum((g[0] for g in god_classes)), then run the harness with --structure <edited copy>

findings.metric_definition: Number of structure_budgets.json keys whose measured value rises when 1201 lines of called CC-1 code are added to a named class, compared key by key with the unpadded measure()
findings.phenomenon_property: A structural budget that takes a maximum over many units prices growth only in the current worst unit
findings.seam_rule: grep -n 'max((' tests/structure.py  # each max-over-units metric in measure()/table_maxima
findings.proposed_fix_scope: tests/structure.py: add a budget key that prices every god class (for example the sum of god-class LOC, or per-class caps), re-recorded with the owner's approval
